cohort: Women giving birth in Central Region, Kenya between July 2008 and June 2012.
finding: The Central Region of Kenya recorded an unsteady declining trend in maternal mortality between 2008 and 2012, with direct causes such as hemorrhage, infection, and pre-eclampsia/eclampsia contributing to the majority of deaths.
mod_finding: Of the audited deaths, 46% had cesarean births, 39% had skilled vaginal deliveries, 13% had unskilled vaginal deliveries, 2% vacuum deliveries, and less than 1% destructive operations.
